INR 30,000/- + 8% HRA for others who do not fall under the above category.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Tirupati Project Associate-I / Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18th September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Chemistry or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 65% marks or an equivalent grade. Research experience in Organic/Inorganic synthesis is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I / Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably not more than 50 years as of the closing date of the advertisement. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government norms, though not explicitly detailed here.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two main stages: initial shortlisting of eligible candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I / Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary is structured in two tiers: INR 37,000/- + 8% HRA for those who qualify through national eligibility tests (like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE), and INR 30,000/- + 8% HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. How should I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your duly filled application form, converted into PDF, along with other required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Associate-I / Junior Research Fellow in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates can proceed with their application without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, meaning the employment is tied to the duration and funding of a specific research project at IISER Tirupati.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IISER Tirupati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Tirupati is located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh. The specific address details can be found in the official notification.
